name_reason: Base name crt_equivalent_fpe_default_handler is compliant (CRT wrapper = crt_equivalent_*) and accurately reflects the function's role: the Watcom CRT default SIGFPE/FPU-exception no-op handler. The _3d26e suffix is exactly the function's own entry address (0x3d26e), i.e. Ghidra address residue, not a domain ID (not a chapter/item/spell/job/portrait ID nor an array dimension), so it must be stripped. Strip suffix only; no semantic change.
purpose: Watcom CRT default SIGFPE / FPU-exception handler: a 1-byte RET no-op installed in the FPE dispatch slot @ 0x5283c so an unhandled FPU exception harmlessly returns until the program installs its own handler via signal(SIGFPE, fn).
logic_summary: Single RET (byte 0xc3). Does nothing: returns immediately. Its sole behavioral role is to be the address seeded into dispatch slot @ 0x5283c (slot contents verified = LE 0x0003d26e). Two indirect-call deliverers reach it through that slot when no user handler is installed: __FPE_exception_ @ 0x4d3d6 (PUSH EAX; CALL [0x5283c]; ADD ESP,4 -- verified) and __int7 @ 0x49fe8 (MOVZX EAX,AH; CALL [0x5283c] at 0x49feb -- verified from bytes 0f b6 c4 ff 15 3c 28 05 00). Address-taken via the slot, so it must stay a real callable function.

params.name: fpe_code
params.semantics: FPU/SIGFPE exception code the deliverer supplies (pushed as a cdecl stack arg by __FPE_exception_; placed in EAX by __int7). The no-op body never reads it; it exists so the slot's PUBDEF carries the correct cdecl signature.
params.reason: Descriptive, accurate, no address residue; matches the value the callers pass.

returns.semantics: No return value. Plain near RET (not RET 4): the cdecl caller reclaims the pushed arg (__FPE_exception_ via ADD ESP,4).

notes: All comment/plate claims cross-checked against ground truth: function body = single RET (mem 0xc3); slot @ 0x5283c = LE 0x0003d26e (points here); __FPE_exception_ call site 0x4d3d6 = PUSH EAX;CALL [0x5283c];ADD ESP,4; __int7 call site 0x49feb = CALL [0x5283c] preceded by MOVZX EAX,AH. src comment (crt.c lines 465-494) is precise and matches; left unchanged. Ghidra plate consistent with refined understanding; left unchanged.
